hero.alt: An Arc burr grinder beside a bag of coffee beans

care.body: Unplug the grinder, remove the hopper and brush the upper burr with the supplied brush. Never use water on the burrs.
care.title: Weekly brush

care.body: Run a cleaning tablet dose through the burrs, then grind 20 g of beans and discard them.
care.title: Monthly deep clean

sections.body: Unplug before cleaning. Keep fingers out of the hopper while the grinder is plugged in.
sections.heading: Safety

sections.body: 1 to 8 espresso, 9 to 16 filter, 17 to 30 pour-over and French press.
sections.heading: Grind settings

sections.body: Two years against manufacturing faults when the grinder is registered to you.
sections.heading: Warranty

steps: Remove the hopper and the catch cup from the packaging.
Place the grinder on a dry, level surface away from the sink.
Seat the hopper and turn it clockwise until it clicks.
setup.title: Unbox and place

steps: Set the dial to 18 for pour-over.
Run 20 g of beans through and discard the grounds.
Adjust one step at a time until the taste is right.
setup.title: First grind

steps: Recalibrate: turn the dial to 0 until the burrs touch, then back to 18.
Unplug and wait ten minutes for the thermal cut-out to reset.
Check the hopper for a jammed bean.
